item.title: Court docs: Man may pay $1.6 million in scam restitution
item.description: A man has agreed to pay back more than $1.6 million as part of a plea deal in an international wire fraud conspiracy that targeted senior citizens across multiple states, including Michigan.

item.title: Kent County snow plow drivers hit side streets
item.description: Tuesday was a rare good day for snowplow drivers and residents alike as plows began tackling stubborn snowpacks across Kent County.

item.title: Grand Rapids agrees to pay $195K to residents impacted by water main break flooding
item.description: The city of Grand Rapids has agreed to settle with the residents of a neighborhood that was flooded in 2024 due to a water main break.

item.title: Leaders see economic boost with proposed Battle Creek missile site
item.description: More than 40 Michigan lawmakers are urging federal officials to select Fort Custer Training Center in Battle Creek as the location for a new missile defense installation.

item.title: A 'tail' of two horses: Meijer Gardens icon's twin stands in Milan
item.description: Frederik Meijer Gardens and Sculpture Park near Grand Rapids is home to Nina Akamu's The American Horse, towering above visitors at 24 feet tall. An identical behemoth stands in front of a horse racing venue in Milan.

item.title: Ask Ellen: Is there a point lake-effect shuts down due to lake ice?
item.description: Lake-effect snow is only possible if there is enough open water for the phenomenon to form, and with ice forming this winter, some Great Lakes have already seen impacts on lake-effect production from the ice cover.

item.title: 'Just a blast': West Michigan woman helping at the Olympics
item.description: When Julie Warnke landed in Milan a little over a week ago, she was only a reserve volunteer. But after a couple days and a little persistence, she got the email that changed her trip completely.
